references.text: The law of the red heifer that has never borne a yoke, parallel to the requirement for a young cow that has not worked
Breaking the neck of an animal as a form of ritual action; the same Hebrew root 'araf' is used
Reference to breaking the neck of a donkey, the same ritual practice of neck-breaking
The immediate context explaining why the elders must perform this ritual with the heifer
Continuation of the ritual where the elders wash their hands over the heifer and declare their innocence
A valley that is not cultivated, similar to the theme of an unused valley
